answer_1.quote: The visual question answering (VQA) task aims to provide a natural language answer to a question based on a given image.
answer_1.outputs: natural language answers to visual questions and clarification questions

answer_2.quote: we employ the following metrics. VQA Accuracy. We evaluate the accuracy of VLMs' responses to ambiguous questions based on the widely adopted VQA Score and Exact Match (EM) metrics.
